caption: The drawing depicts a large, metallic tankard with a domed lid, a pronounced circular handle, and a thumb lever on top for opening the lid. The tankard is cylindrical in shape and has two horizontal bands encircling the body near the bottom. The metallic surface is shaded to reflect light, creating a realistic texture and appearance. The main drawing is highly detailed in grayscale, showing varying intensities and gradients to indicate volume and light reflection. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same tankard in profile, showing the general shape and proportions. The background of the drawing is plain, and the artist's name and date ("Emelia Tuccio-1931") appear in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Tankard
